# Habr Career public HTML fixtures

Captured: 2026-10-04 from read-only public Habr Career vacancy listing pages.

Sources:
- https://career.habr.com/vacancies?sort=date&page=1
- https://career.habr.com/vacancies?sort=date&page=2

Observed contract: 25 `.vacancy-card` records per page, numeric `/vacancies/<id>` links, ISO `time[datetime]` on cards, and pagination anchors with `page`, `sort=date`, `type=all`.
